description: Checks a task run_model returned (no key needed: the task_id is the capability). Waits up to 30 s for it to finish; returns the result when completed, else its status: then call check_task again, never resubmit. Task results are kept 1 h after they finish.

inline_images.description: Also return images ≤ 1 MB as image content blocks (default false: links only).

task_id.description: The task_id from run_model, e.g. direct:2f9c…

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for it to finish (0–30, default 30); 0 just reads the status.

name: check_task
title: Check a Relay task
